scheme_name: Educational Allowances to the Children of Widows
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or have continuous residence there for at least 3 years
Child of the applicant must be a student
Child must have obtained at least 50% marks in every class
benefits_summary: Financial assistance ranging from ₹25 to ₹125 for purchase of textbooks, notebooks, etc.
